rules.bound_owner_id: Ownership-changing transfers are rejected unless the destination owner matches the projected bound owner.
rules.quest_owner_id: Quest ownership-changing transfers are rejected unless the destination owner matches the projected quest owner.
rules.no_trade: Trade staging is rejected when explicitly true.
rules.no_destroy: Ordinary destruction is rejected when explicitly true.
rules.quest_protected: Ordinary destruction is rejected when explicitly true.
rules.administrative_remove: Permission-gated administrative infrastructure may bypass projected destruction restrictions while retaining an explicit result marker.

fallback: Unknown or unmapped Classic flags remain inactive; malformed projected metadata fails validation.
